title: Kit usage by session, version 1
description: One Mac's Usage by session list for one period, as the Kit sends it on /mac after want_usage: each session's share of the person's Claude Code use on that Mac in the period, and the part its agents did. Each reply counts at its model's API price, so a share follows how the usage limit fills; a share is never a percent of the limit, which Anthropic gives only as a total. Only names, ids and numbers go up: no path, no prompt, no reply. See phone/DESIGN.md, section 14.

period.description: today, 7d (today and the 6 days before), 30d, or a range of days, first..last, in the Mac's time zone.

share.description: Percent of the person's use on this Mac in the period.

title.description: The session's name, cut to 160 characters. Never a prompt or a reply.

cse.description: The Remote Control session id, for Open in Claude; null for use with no session link (a session only on that Mac, the Kit's own checks, runs in temporary folders).

agent_share.description: The part of share its agents did, in percent of the person's use; never more than share.

agents.description: Agents it started in the period.

from.description: The first day the list covers.

to.description: The last day the list covers.

at.description: Unix seconds: when the Mac made the list.

agent_share.description: The part of the person's use that agents did.

usd.description: The use, in dollars at API prices.

more.description: The sessions after the first 100, together.
